title: Chapter 716 - 716 Alliance; Chaos!
content:
Chapter 716 - 716 Alliance; Chaos!

Chapter 716 - 716 Alliance; Chaos!

716 Alliance; Chaos!

Zhu Yan’s curse today was only the beginning.

After that, he suffered a stronger curse every day.

Five years later, Zhu Yan became extremely crazy and violent. He had the urge to destroy everything.

Not long after, the Fire God Palace and the Demon Sect joined forces and launched a fierce attack on the Water God Palace, the 10,000 Demons Sect, and the Thunder Sect. The scope of the battle affected several universes.

Chaos and blood continued to spread.

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

However, a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Your enemy’s demonic will has exploded because of your curse, and his temperament has changed drastically.]

When Lin Fan heard this, his eyes lit up.

“After spending so many spirit stones, there’s finally some effect.”

So many spirit stones?

If Lin Fan’s words were heard by others, who knew what kind of expression they would have.

One had to know…

In the universe, spirit stones were the lowest and most common cultivation items.

Generally speaking, one spirit crystal could be exchanged for 100 million spirit stones.

This was only the public exchange price.

In fact, very few people would exchange for it like this.

This was because the pure energy contained in spirit crystals was far beyond that of spirit stones.

Generally speaking, only 150 million spirit stones or even 200 million spirit stones for one spirit crystal would be considered.

Ever since he started cursing Zhu Yan, Lin Fan had not spent a total of 100 million spirit crystals.

As for Zhu Yan, he was the palace master of the Fire God Palace. His cultivation base had reached at least the Emperor level!

Such a small price had caused a powerhouse at least at the Emperor level to develop a demonic nature.

It had to be said that the power of the Saint-level Curse was truly shocking.

Lin Fan was still complaining?

In order to appease the dissatisfaction in his heart, Lin Fan cursed Zhu Yan.

…

On the other hand, in the distant starry sky.

The higher-ups of the Water God Palace, the 10,000 Demons Sect, and the Thunder Sect gathered together.

“120 planets of our 10,000 Demons Sect have already been attacked.”

“48 planets of our Thunder Sect has been destroyed.”

“Forget about the Demon Sect, have all the people from the Fire God Palace gone crazy?”

“Do they really think they can take down all three of us? Who gave them the confidence?”

“I propose to form an alliance of the Water God Palace, the 10,000 Demons Sect, and the Thunder Sect to fight against the Fire God Palace and the Demon Sect.”

“Agreed!”

“Agreed!”

…

An even more intense chaos continued to spread.

…

Ten years passed in a flash.

In the past ten years, Lin Fan had obtained five Immortal Crystals, four Transcendence Golden Bodies, three King-level equipment, and two Emperor-level equipment from the system.

Lin Fan frowned. “It’s been so long. I’m still so close to breaking through to level-nine Universe. That’s too slow.”

Too slow?

If others heard this, who knew what kind of expression they would have?

One had to know…

A few decades ago, Lin Fan was just an ordinary Star Traveller-level cultivator.

Such a cultivation speed was simply faster than sitting on a rocket.

At this moment, a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! It’s been 95 years since you’ve obtained the advanced system. Rewards: Intermediate Rule Upgrade Gem x 1, Immortal Crystal x 1, Transcendence Golden Body x 1.]

When Lin Fan saw the Intermediate Rule Upgrade Gem, his heart skipped a beat.

He suddenly remembered that he had also obtained one more than ten years ago.

However, he had always forgotten to use it.

Now, they could be used together.

He slowly focused his attention on Life Laws and Death Laws.

[Ding, upgrade successful!]

Instantly, Lin Fan had a deeper understanding of life and death.

With a wave of his hand, a white energy filled with vitality and a black energy filled with death appeared in front of him.

The white energy kept condensing and transforming. Small, nimble people appeared.

The black energy kept twisting, turning into a hideous demon.

It was very strange.

“Whoosh!”

Lin Fan waved his hand once more, and the white energy and black energy dissipated.

Then, with a slight thought, he directly entered the River of Time.

He took a step forward and walked on the path of death.

100 meters.

500 meters.

100 meters.

3,000 meters.

5,000 meters.

…

As he walked farther away, the pressure on Lin Fan’s body started to increase.

At 7,200 meters, he finally stopped.

Then, he took a step to the left and walked on the life path.

100 meters.

500 meters.

1,000 meters.

3,000 meters.

5,000 meters.

6,000 meters.

Just as Lin Fan was starting to feel a little tired, a crisp voice suddenly sounded behind him.

“Huh? Your comprehension of Life Laws has actually reached such a level?”

When Lin Fan heard the voice, he turned around slowly.

He saw a woman with a graceful figure, snow-white skin, and exquisite facial features beside him.

It was Kathleen from the Temple of Life.

“A super genius who’s less than 2,000 years old…”

Kathleen used her beautiful eyes to size up Lin Fan.

After a while, she said, “Lin Fan, are you willing to join the Temple of Life? With your talent, you can definitely become the disciple of the temple master.”

Lin Fan shook his head. “I’m sorry, I don’t have any plans to take anyone as my master.”

Many people wanted to take a master because they wanted to obtain cultivation techniques, legacies, resources, and so on.

However, Lin Fan did not lack these.

On the contrary, becoming a disciple would also cause him to lose his freedom.

Since that was the case, Lin Fan naturally would not choose to take a master.

“Lin Fan, don’t be so quick to reject me. You might not know much about the Temple of Life. The temple master is an Emperor-level powerhouse!

“Now, the Fire God Palace and the Demon Sect have joined forces to attack the Water God Palace, the 10,000 Demons Sect, and the Thunder Sect. This has caused many universes to fall into chaos, but the Temple of Life has not been affected at all.

“Because the founder of the Temple of Life is a high and mighty Saint Lord!

“If you join the Temple of Life, it’ll be easier for you to attract the attention of the Saint Lords.”

Obviously, Kathleen thought highly of Lin Fan.

Otherwise, she would not have explained so much.

Lin Fan could feel Kathleen’s anticipation.

However, he still shook his head and said, “Sorry, I prefer to be free.”

Saint Lord… It was undoubtedly an extremely powerful existence.

The stronger they were, the more they would restrict others.

Furthermore, Lin Fan was confident that he could reach the level of a Saint Lord as well.

Why should he be restricted by others?

Kathleen seemed to have noticed Lin Fan’s confidence and could not help but take another look at him.

After a moment, she said, “Since that’s the case, I’ll teach you some comprehension and cultivation techniques of Life Laws. I hope you can walk farther and farther on the path of life.”

After saying that, she stretched out her slender finger and tapped Lin Fan’s forehead lightly.

Instantly, Lin Fan’s mind was filled with many complicated and profound life attribute insights.

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Kathleen’s favorability toward you has increased to five stars.]

When Lin Fan heard the voice, he came back to his senses.

“See you next time,” Kathleen said with a smile.

As soon as she finished speaking, she quickly walked away along the life path.
